name: Seastone cuffs
description: Cuffs of the stone that holds the sea's power: a fruit user who wears them cannot use the fruit, or stand straight.

name: Seastone net
description: A net woven with seastone threads. Whoever is caught is held; a fruit user caught goes limp.

name: Seastone bullets
description: Rounds with seastone cores. Fired from a gun of yours, they touch a Logia and weaken any fruit user they hit.

name: Seastone edge
description: A seastone strip a smith fits along a blade's edge: the sword you carry will touch what a sword should not.

name: Den Den Mushi
description: A snail that carries a voice to its kin across any sea. With it you can call anyone whose number you have.

name: Black Den Den Mushi
description: A small black snail that listens in on other snails' calls. Every harbour's news reaches you as it happens.

name: White Den Den Mushi
description: A snail that jams the snails around it: nobody calls for help while it is out.

name: Visual Den Den Mushi
description: A snail that sees and shows what it saw: a camera with a shell.

name: Broadcast Den Den Mushi
description: A great snail that speaks to every snail in the world at once. Only the World Government keeps them.

name: Vivre Card
description: A scrap of paper made from a person's nail clipping. It creeps toward its owner, and burns down as their life fades.

name: Sea charts
description: Good charts of the currents and reefs, copied by someone who sailed them.

name: Navigator's kit
description: Sextant, compass, chronometer and dividers in a brass-bound case.

name: Weather almanac
description: A scholar's tables of the Grand Line's moods, as far as they can be tabled.

name: Diving bell
description: An iron bell with a window and an air hose: a way down to wrecks for those without gills.

name: Treasure tree wood
description: Timber of the treasure tree Adam, sold in pieces on the black market for a fortune: enough for one ship's hull.

name: Forged papers
description: A name, a port of origin and a stamp that will fool most harbourmasters.

name: Freedom papers
description: A bought, forged or stolen document that says someone once owned is free. On Sabaody it is worth a life.

name: Pacifista
description: A cyborg weapon of the World Government, built in the image of a Warlord. Nobody outside the Government has one.

name: Seraphim
description: The Government's newest weapon: a child-sized giant made from the lineage of the strongest. Not for anyone's hands.

name: Raid suit
description: A suit of science from a kingdom of soldiers, stored in a can and worn like a second skin.
